item.title: Jill Scott pays homage to North Philly on new album 'To Whom This May Concern'
item.description: Jill Scott's first album in a decade includes a track honoring North Philly. 'Norf Side,' in collaboration with fellow Philadelphian Tierra Whack, includes multiple shoutouts to the neighborhood.

item.title: How Philadelphia became the sweet spot for America's iconic holiday candies
item.description: Philadelphia was once America's candy capital, home to chocolatiers who created Whitman's Sampler, Peanut Chews and bubble gum. Many beloved Valentine's Day treats and holiday candies have Pennsylvania roots.

item.title: Amid concern over ICE raids in region, Philly school district reaffirms policy to protect students
item.description: The School District of Philadelphia sent a letter to families Friday reaffirming its policy to protect student privacy and safety if ICE agents conduct operations near schools. The district said there have been no verified reports of ICE at school properties.

item.title: Sixers rookie VJ Edgecombe named 2026 NBA Rising Stars MVP after scoring both game-winners for Team Vince
item.description: VJ Edgecombe predictably brought his intensity and clutch nature to Los Angeles for All-Star weekend. He had two game-winning shots in as many contests.

item.title: Atlantic City Boat Show returns with hundreds of boats and hands-on demos
item.description: The Discover Boating Atlantic City Boat Show returns to the Atlantic City Convention Center from Wednesday, Feb. 25 through Sunday, March 1, bringing five days focused on life on the water.

item.title: National Cancer Institute is studying ivermectin's 'ability to kill cancer cells'
item.description: The National Cancer Institute is studying ivermectin as a potential cancer treatment despite having no new evidence suggesting the antiparasitic drug may be effective. The drug's popularity surged during the COVID-19 pandemic as fringe medical groups promoted it as an effective treatment, but there's no evidence it does that, either.

item.title: Mailbag: Will Jalen Hurts be the Eagles' starting quarterback in 2027?
item.description: In a word: yes. But a more in-depth look at that, A.J.Brown trade rumors, and other Eagles questions entering the offseason.

item.title: The Phillies' lineup never left 2023
item.description: Rob Thomson might insist that the Phillies aren't running it back, but the projected lineup will still consist of seven out of nine bats who have continually fallen short, and are only getting older.

item.title: 'The Sound of Music' is coming to the Academy of Music this spring
item.description: One of Broadway’s most beloved musicals is headed back to Philadelphia.

item.title: Sixers guard Tyrese Maxey eliminated in first round of 2026 NBA 3-Point Contest
item.description: Tyrese Maxey could not continue the Sixers' All-Star weekend momentum created by rookie VJ Edgecombe.
